claim: LncDach1 does not alter Nav1.5 gating.
source: One difference of our data with Scn5a gain-of-function mutation is that the kinetics of peak INa often change during mutation, while it is not the case of lncDach1 knockout. One possible explanation may be that lncDach1 does not alter Nav1.5 gating, and the late Na current may not be enhanced to the same effect as observed with LQT gain-of-function Nav1.5 mutations, in which APD prolongation is attributed to gating defects that increase late Na current.
evidence: This is a speculative explanation proposed by the authors to explain why increased peak INa in lncDach1-cKO mice does not increase arrhythmia susceptibility.
